about: (v355-N2) Ibn ʿAqīl's work order, the complements and the followers: 18 Nahw342Engine rows + IdafaEngine (أل behind و/ف closes the chain; أل head annexes before أل + written kasra; ـَانِ + ـَانِ is no chain). tools/grammar_audit.js before → after: jumla 130/25, sign 60, kase 321, taalluq 228/200, adab 569, inna 17, tartib 0, mansub 17 — all unchanged; sh336 21 → 22: the one new record below. Over every story token (scratchpad dump, 90,147 tokens; 1,679 lines changed): the authored «مضاف» on a head agreeing 7,634 → 7,634 while the engine's «وهو مضاف» falls 9,211 → 8,782 (429 wrong annexations gone — وَالْـ nouns, the dual's nūn); «مضاف إليه» agreeing 6,693 → 6,700 (engine 8,069 → 7,811); the lām of jarr on لَكَ / لَهُ … 39 → 764 agreeing (engine 766; the 2 others C: Talkhīṣ «له خبر مقدم» is the same jārr-majrūr); «اسم تفضيل» 31 → 56 (engine 66 → 216, the rest the authors leave unnamed); the specified noun of praise / blame 0 → 14; the wonder 1 → 5; نعت 2,589 → 2,662; تمييز 149 → 151; the tawkīd maʿnawī 0 → 3; عِنْدِ after مِنْ (15 tokens) «مجرور بمن، مما لزم الظرفية أو شبهها: لا يخرج عن الظرفية إلا مجرورا بمن» (Ibn ʿAqīl p. 2:199) — the authors' «مجرور بمن» agrees. Judged new lines against an author: L 1 (Taṣrīf al-ʿIzzī 1:s2 «لِمَعَانٍ» «مجرور به بالكسرة» — the kasra is the tanwīn of compensation, the jarr sign the fatḥa estimated on the dropped yāʾ: Ibn ʿAqīl p. 3:327; in research/story-corrections-proposed-2026-11-27.aqil-n2.jsonl); C 6 (the Kāfiya's cited forms of the wonder and كَفَى بِـ, al-Uṣūl al-Munīfa «كَفَى بِنَفْسِكَ» «مجرور به» — the extra bāʾ is the books' reading; the al-ṣifa annexations الْمُعْتَلُّ الْعَيْنِ / الْتِقَاءُ السَّاكِنَيْنِ the authors leave unnamed); 9 role guesses of Murib's own (أَمْرَانِ، صِنْفَانِ، مَقْبُولَانِ، ضَعِيفَانِ، أَفْتَلَانِ، كُلُّهُ، عَشَرَ ×2، الطَّرِيقَ) uncovered where the wrong muḍāf ilayh was removed — they were wrong before as muḍāf ilayh and are Murib's role table, handed over to v355-N1.

cite.ar: إذا وقع اسم الفاعل صلة للألف واللام عمل ماضيا ومستقبلا وحالا لوقوعه حينئذ موقع الفعل

records.why: Both lines say the same: «مَجَامِعَ» is the object of the al-participle «وَالطَّاعِنِينَ» (the author: «مفعول به للطاعنين منصوب، مضاف»; the engine: «مفعول به لاسم الفاعل «والطاعنين»، وهو مضاف»). The record is new only because IdafaEngine no longer annexes «وَالطَّاعِنِينَ» (أل behind the wāw, the plural's nūn kept), which had hidden the participle's object.
